verdict.rationale: Baseten documents asynchronous inference (request ID returned quickly, completion via webhook/polling) suited for batch workloads, but the only discount mechanism documented is automatic KV-cache discounting for cached prompt tokens — there is no documented pricing tier or discount specifically for async/batch jobs versus real-time synchronous calls. Missing for 10: explicit batch/async pricing page or discount percentage, confirmation that async requests are billed differently than sync requests, and any community/independent corroboration of async cost savings.
